practical_relevance.prediction_time: Retrospective published-snapshot forecast correction. Input official forecast for target hour, preceding-hour forecast, and actual/forecast residuals 48 and168 hours before target. This timestamp statement does not establish their actual publication availability. No target-hour demand, generation or interchange predictor.
